summary: legal checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch or monetization expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Keep the gated product private and external outreach unsent. Evidence: upstream API materials establish access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, retain historical data, send alerts, use images/trademarks/prices, or monetize. Technical compliance is incomplete at 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, and any affiliate, advertising, public-display, or alert-expansion decision.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closable because current API, terms, support, repository, privacy, and cookie-policy evidence is partial. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted caching/display/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; capture existing consent, withdrawal, GA4 property, data-sharing, and retention settings without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed; produce a read-only log, vendor, retention, access, incident, and data-request inventory.

Fleet compliance and data-quality triage: retain consent, cookie and analytics disclosures, withdrawal behavior, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, provenance and rights records, copyright and trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards where supported by site evidence. Do not infer site category from domain names or treat incomplete telemetry as zero. Parked or unreachable sites require a concrete retain-parked or bounded-launch decision and completed site-specific checklist before exposure or monetization. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only where existing consent, disclosures, data handling, claims, and platform-policy boundaries are preserved.
